title: Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro Training Notes: Trust Scale on Incentive Reserves
content:
**The rule.** On a **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** earnings account whose payout hold is lifted, the incentive reserve kept back from the hold-release payout (the reserve base multiplied by the reserve rate) is then multiplied by the trust scale. The trust scale follows the current rating on the driver's driver services agreement and whether a safety report about the driver was recorded on the standing record within the last 6 whole months; both are records of the driver's agreement under **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing**:

- a rating at or above 4.9 with no such safety report scales the reserve by 0.5;
- a rating at or above 4.8 but below 4.9 with no such safety report scales it by 0.75;
- any other rating, or any such safety report, leaves the reserve unscaled.

**Q. Which rating is read?** The current rating on the driver's driver services agreement, as it stands when the hold is lifted.

**Q. Which standing entries matter?** Only safety reports recorded on the agreement's standing record in the last 6 whole months. Warnings, document entries, rating reviews and background rechecks on the standing record do not enter this scale.

**Q. What does one safety report do?** Any safety report in the last 6 whole months leaves the reserve unscaled, whatever the rating.

## Combinations

| Current rating on the agreement | Safety report in the last 6 whole months? | Trust scale |
|---|---|---|
| 4.9 or higher | No | 0.5 |
| 4.9 or higher | Yes | Unscaled (1) |
| 4.8 up to but not including 4.9 | No | 0.75 |
| 4.8 up to but not including 4.9 | Yes | Unscaled (1) |
| Below 4.8 | No | Unscaled (1) |
| Below 4.8 | Yes | Unscaled (1) |

## Boundary readings (hypothetical ratings, no safety report)

| Rating | Trust scale |
|---|---|
| 4.90 | 0.5 |
| 4.89 | 0.75 |
| 4.80 | 0.75 |
| 4.79 | Unscaled |

**Hypothetical figure.** A reserve base multiplied by the reserve rate of 40.00, for a driver rated 4.93 with no safety report, becomes an incentive reserve of 20.00 (40.00 multiplied by 0.5).
